datasets.name: CreditAnalysDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.boorowerid, p.id creditid, p.branchid, p.currency, p.numberofcredit,
       p.customertype, p.credittype, p.usrgroup, p.usid, p.personaltype,
       p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,p.closedate,
       h.rest, h.interestrest, h.duerest, h.dueinterestrest, v.val_name,
       v.valute, cm_common.accountnumber_get (a.contractaccid) AS contractaccno
  FROM cm_portfolio p, cm_curr_state h, sb_avalute v, cm_accounts a
 WHERE (h.creditid = p.id)
   AND (v.valute = p.currency)
   AND (p.boorowerid = :boorowerid)
   AND (a.creditid = p.id)
ORDER BY :orderfield

datasets.name: CustomersDataSet
datasets.sql:
select id,name
from cm_sb_customers
order by name

datasets.name: CustAnalysDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.id boorowerid, c.NAME boorowername
           FROM cm_sb_customers c
          WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT p.boorowerid
                           FROM cm_portfolio p
                          WHERE p.boorowerid = c.id)
       --c.ID in (select P.BoorowerID from CM_Portfolio P )    
   ORDER BY :orderfield

datasets.name: TrancheDataSet
datasets.sql:
select T.trancheamount,T.tranchedate
from cm_tranches T
where creditid =:CrdID

datasets.name: PaymentsDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, creditid, paydate, payedamt, payedintamt, payeddueamt,
       payeddueintamt, payedpenaltyamt
  FROM cm_payments
WHERE CreditID=:CrdID

datasets.name: CreditsinDateDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT hdate,rest, interestrest,
       duerest, dueinterestrest
  FROM cm_history
  where creditid=:crdid 
    and hdate between :D1 and :D2 
order by hdate desc

datasets.name: ScheduleDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, creditid, paymentdate, principal, interest
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE CreditID=:CrdID

datasets.name: ProlongationDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT  prolongdate, newclosedate
  FROM cm_prolongations
where creditid =:CrdID

datasets.name: SumSheDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT  creditid,sum(principal),sum(interest)
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE CreditID=:CrdID
group by CreditID

datasets.name: SumPayDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT creditid,  sum(payedamt), sum(payedintamt), sum(payeddueamt),
       sum(payeddueintamt), sum(payedpenaltyamt)
  FROM cm_payments
WHERE CreditID=:CrdID
Group by creditid

datasets.name: ReportDataSet
datasets.sql:
select 
      p.numberofcredit,
      p.dateofconclusion,
      p.closedate,
      p.purposeofcredit,
      p.creditlineamount,
      p.annualyinterestrate,
      p.annualyoverduerate,
      p.annualypenaltyrate,
      per.descripion,
      cat.description,
      crd.description,
      usrgr.description,
      val.val_name,
      plg.pledgename,
      GET_RESERVES_NAME(h.reserveid) as resrevename,
      GET_RESERVES_NAME(h.duereserveid) as dueresrevename,
      h.pledgeprice
from 
    cm_portfolio p,
    cm_persons per,
    cm_categories cat,
    cm_credittypes crd,
    cm_usergroups usrgr,
    sb_avalute val,
    cm_guarantee plg,
    cm_curr_state h
where 
    p.personaltype = per.id and    
    p.customertype = cat.id and
    p.credittype = crd.id and
    p.usrgroup = usrgr.id and
    p.currency = val.valute and
    p.id = h.creditid and
    p.id = plg.creditid and
    p.id = :CrdID
